glossary.scope: As used in sections 3902.11 to 3902.14 of the Revised Code:

glossary.definition: (C) "Provider" means a hospital, nursing home, physician, podiatrist, dentist, pharmacist, chiropractor, or other licensed health care provider entitled to reimbursement by a third-party payer for services rendered to a beneficiary under a benefits contract.
